lines.l: We were taken from the promised land
And was brought on this pollution
But, oh, be on to the one who brought us from Africa to where
We were treated with brutality and no love or human rights
But, oh dry man, I know we dream on the line
Cause now is the time for I and I to go
We were stripped and ganged, we were beaten to the ground, we were robbed of our beautiful lands.
But, oh, come on, I know we draped on the land, cause now is the time for Ionite to rule.
We were beaten to the ground
We were robbed of her beautiful life
I know it went on the land
Cause now is the time for I and I to go
When the windows of the world
Shall be taken to the door
And blood shall flow like the waters of night
